name: Squid Game X
creator: redifi
redeem: Launch Squid Game X on Roblox and wait for the lobby to finish loading.
Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
Click the Codes button in the bottom-right corner of the Shop menu.
Type or paste the code into the Insert your code here box and press Enter on your keyboard.
notes:
Squid Game X is a survival party game from the redifi group, inspired by the Netflix series and running on Roblox since 2021. Each round drops a lobby of players into a string of elimination challenges such as Red Light, Green Light, Honeycomb, Tug of War, Marbles and Glass Bridge, with newer modes like Mingle, Musical Chairs and Jump Rope, until one survivor is left.

Codes award Coins, which you can spend on boosts such as sprint or damage upgrades that improve your odds in the harder games. The developers tie their bigger codes to like milestones, with the current one promised at 1.4 million likes, and they also share codes through their Roblox group, Discord and X account.

faq.q: When is the next big Squid Game X code coming out?
faq.a: The game's description says the next big code will drop when Squid Game X reaches 1.4M likes.

faq.q: What do I get for joining the redifi Roblox group?
faq.a: The developers say group members get bonus daily rewards and codes, plus a FAN tag in the game.

faq.q: What are Coins from Squid Game X codes used for?
faq.a: Coins can be spent on boosts, such as sprint or damage upgrades, that improve your odds in the harder games.

tips: In Red Light, Green Light, stop the moment the light changes. Moving even a little at the wrong time gets you eliminated.
A round runs through many modes, so learn them one at a time. Knowing the tricky ones, like Honeycomb and Glass Bridge, keeps you alive longer.
Newer modes like Musical Chairs, Jump Rope, Sky Squid and Final Dinner can catch you off guard. Watch how other players handle them the first few times.
If you get eliminated, stay and watch. Seeing how the winners play each game is a quick way to learn for your next round.
useRewards: The current code, $1.2M, gives Coins. Coins buy boosts that help in the harder games, so save them for the modes you lose most instead of spending on the first boost you see. Type the code with the dollar sign, the dot and the capital M exactly as shown. Big codes come at like milestones, so redeem each one quickly.
